Tesseract.js 7.0.0 browser distribution, copied unchanged from the runtime's npm package.
Upstream: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js (Apache-2.0).
Bundled dependency notices are included in *.LICENSE.txt.
Core WASM and English trained data are downloaded from pinned jsDelivr package URLs
inside the OCR worker. Screenshot pixels are processed locally, not uploaded.
